Container.Name: PokeSim
Container.Overview: Pokémon Red, Blue, Yellow, Gold, Silver and Crystal that play themselves while you're away. Watch in your browser and take control whenever you like. Bring your own legally dumped ROMs, none are included. Add one in the browser under Settings, then Game cartridges. Set PUBLIC_URL to the exact address you open in the browser, for example http://tower.local:8930.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Host port for the browser UI.

Config.Name: PUBLIC_URL
Config.Description: The exact address you open in the browser. Requests for any other host are refused.

Config.Name: PORT
Config.Description: Port inside the container. Leave at 8000.

Config.Name: NTFY_URL
Config.Description: Optional ntfy topic URL for notifications. Notifications are normally set up in the Library.

Config.Name: NTFY_MIN_PRIORITY
Config.Description: Lowest ntfy priority to send, 1 to 5.

Config.Name: NTFY_MUTE
Config.Description: Optional comma separated event kinds to mute.
